cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 87% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.95% · WTI +2.73% · Brent +3.06% · NatGas +1.73%. 87% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.87%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.87%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.41%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +16.10%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +16.10%, EOSE +12.11%, VRT +6.67%, ARRY +6.45%, FLNC +5.74%. Laggards: FSLR -1.35%, PEG -0.81%, NXT -0.78%, DUK -0.67%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
